final_sql:
SELECT MAX("frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM "frpm"
JOIN "schools" ON "frpm"."CDSCode" = "schools"."CDSCode"
WHERE "schools"."County" = 'Alameda';
